answer: Continuous hardware attestation ledger ties each identity to a device's physical clock drift and sensor noise, values a single operator cannot fake across many units. An agent that lets its drift wander outside the recorded envelope is ejected at the ledge of tolerance, forcing attackers to acquire distinct physical hardware per identity. Copies run on one host share a reef of correlated noise signatures, collapsing the Sybil set. Each forged identity thus costs a real device plus ongoing attestation bandwidth.
